newsitem.title: USA: Swisher Intl Q2 share $0.07 vs $0.06.
newsitem.headline: Swisher Intl Q2 share $0.07 vs $0.06.

text.p: Swisher International Inc said Thursday that, in its second quarter, it had earnings of $0.07 per share on 2,355,002 shares outstanding and revenue of $3,096,652, up from $0.06 per share with 1,794,649 shares outstanding on revenue of $2,409,397 in the prior year's second quarter.
The company, whose second quarter ended April 30, declined to provide net income figures.

The company said the major factor in the overall increase is the continued growth of annuity revenues, which is the revenue the company receives from royalties, service fees, management fees and the sale of products to its franchisees.
Annuity revenues for the three month period increased 37 percent to $2,318,883, the company said.
Swisher is a franchisor of commercial hygiene services and products.
